dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Sheecago is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Sheecago has been observed to be highly dog reactive and leash bite. When taking Sheecago out of kennel for a medical exam, Sheecago bit the handler's leash. While being walked out of the kennel room, Sheecago began pulling intensely towards other dogs, and bit a dog's tongue while they were licking the kennel bars (no skin was broken). When interacting with Sheecago, she is observed to have a tense body in kennel and remain at the back. With a slow approach, Sheecago has shown curiosity in coming forward and interacting with enrichment. Medically, Sheecago is apparently healthy.

Sheecago arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, she has been observed to be fearful and kennel reactive. Noted to hard bark at handlers when approached and will cage fight significantly. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only, single pet home with no trips to the dog park.
dog.name: Sheecago
